   - `systemctl daemon-reload`

#!/usr/bin/env bash
# systemctl shim for Qisutu installation in a non-systemd container

# Parse options

ARGS=()
for a in "$@"; do
  case "$a" in
    --now) NOW=1; ;;
    -*) ;;  # ignore other flags
    *) ARGS+=("$a"); ;;
  esac
done
CMD="${ARGS[0]}"

```

while true; do

    DAEMON=$(grep -m1 'ExecStart=/bin/systemctl enable --now ' "$SERVICE_FILE" | awk '{print $NF}')

    rm -f "$SERVICE_FILE" "/etc/systemd/system/${INSTANCE}-install-complete.path"
    break
  fi
  sleep 1
done
```
